events.description: Attack targeting U.S. forces in Aden, attributed to the southern Yemeni group. Text says someone (name redacted) received training for this operation.
CIA issued a report on Usama bin Ladin's links to a southern Yemeni group.
The southern Yemeni group was responsible for an attack targeting U.S. forces in Aden. Participants reportedly received training for the operation.
The CIA issued a terrorism report on Usama bin Ladin's links to a southern Yemeni group and distributed it to US agencies. The time of transmission was 052108Z MAR 97.

relationships.detail: The report subject is bin Ladin's links to this group; the nature of the link is redacted or illegible in the available text.

relationships.detail: The group is described as a southern Yemeni group.
Aden is a city in Yemen. The link is inferred from the text, which places the Yemeni group's attack in Aden.
The fragmentary text says someone received training for the Aden operation. The trainer is not legible and is likely bin Ladin-linked, so this is low-confidence.
The CIA disseminated the report to DIRNSA, among other addressees.

key_claims: A southern Yemeni group was responsible for the 1992 attack targeting U.S. forces in Aden.
Someone (name redacted) reportedly received training for the 1992 Aden operation.
A CIA report dated 5 March 1997 assessed Usama bin Ladin's links to this group.
The report was widely distributed to U.S. intelligence, law enforcement, military and transportation agencies.
